note:
A floor re-derived without saying which units were real is the same defect in fresher paint, so:

12 is correct and was correct when banked; this note corrects only its attribution, which over-claimed by one unit.

THE STALE-FLOOR HALF STANDS. The floor was 16, stamped at a commit git cannot resolve in this repository, so it had been measured on a tree this branch never had and the gate was failing `exact` in the LOW direction -- an improvement fails the build exactly as a regression does. Two sessions measured 14 at two different pre-fix parents.

THE UNIT SPLIT WAS WRONG. The superseded note said "16 -> 12, of which only 2 are this change". Measured in a clean detached worktree:

    dbd98c0f685  14   my own previous commit, which I mistook for the parent
    7ad0d418746  13   odoo-60's mrp.workorder._inverse_qty_producing split
    cf37e193c26  13   the TRUE parent of 1f3ea59c8f6
    1f3ea59c8f6  12   this change

Five commits landed between dbd98c0f685 and 1f3ea59c8f6, one of which moved this count. So one unit is this change and one is odoo-60's, and the error was measuring against my own last commit rather than against `<tip>^`.

THE UNIT THAT IS THIS CHANGE: pos.config._default_warehouse_id served `default=` on warehouse_id AND was called on self from create(), which is ADR-0051 exactly. Split as the ADR prescribes -- the hook keeps its name and its `.id` return and delegates to _get_default_warehouse, which is what create() calls now. create() wanted the record to exist, not its id, and was spending a falsy id to ask.

Two readings do not settle attribution. "Nothing else landed between them" is a third fact and it is answerable only from `git log`; measure at `<tip>^`, not at whatever you happened to commit last.

--- RE-MEASURED 2026-09-01 ---
This branch was squashed from 42 commits and replayed onto origin/19.0-marin (99 upstream commits), so every SHA the note above cites was rewritten and resolves to nothing. The figure below is re-derived in a clean detached worktree at 3cfc16542e7, with a second worktree at origin/19.0-marin as the control, so the branch's own contribution is attributed rather than assumed.
origin/19.0-marin 16 -> this tip 12. All 4 units are this branch's.
